Brave women in Iran are risking everything to confront one of the world's most violent, repressive regimes.

With Iran at UNGA, we must demand investigations into its human rights violations and treatment of prisoners and protestors.

We must fight for freedom at home and abroad.

Today in Artsakh, a hospital patient died because Azerbaijan's blockade cut them off from treatment.
 
Many patients are still at risk. Basic supplies are running low.
 
The humanitarian crisis is no longer potential - it’s here. I'm urging @POTUS to help ensure Artsakh's safety. https://t.co/orZ331dMvW

Today, Republicans are taking up a bill that prioritizes dangerous culture wars over students.

The bIll promotes censorship, book bans, and excludes schools from nutrition programs. 

The only education this bill provides, is how to undermine our public schools.

30 Million students in the U.S. depend on school meals. 

When schools close, kids are left hungry. 

That’s why I’m proud to join @Ilhan & @RepJahanaHayes in introducing the School Meals During School Closures Act to ensure students get the nutrition they need.

Delayed medical care. Denied treatment. Preventable deaths.

The evidence of mishandling of the Adelanto ICE Processing Center is overwhelming. 

It's time for @DHSgov to terminate the GEO group’s contract and close it for good.

For too long, DACA recipients have been barred from getting the coverage they deserve – despite paying billions in taxes each year.

This decision by President Biden will help improve the health and well-being of thousands of DACA recipients in California and across the country.

For those facing medical issues, financial instability can seriously impair treatment and recovery. 

Read more about my Guaranteed Income for Working Families Act – which would reduce healthcare costs by providing income security:

Patients deserve care, not confinement for profit.

I’m demanding answers from Acadia Healthcare after reports of abuse, wrongful detainment, and profiteering at their psychiatric facilities.

Read my full letter:
https://t.co/KfODaEQI3x

I pushed CMS to expand PrEP coverage under Medicare — and now it’s happening.

No more out-of-pocket costs for these life-saving medications.

This is a huge step forward in the fight against HIV, ensuring access for all Medicare enrollees who need it.

RFK Jr. will not make America healthy again.

But his ignorance may make people sick again.
Deprive them of the treatment they need again.
Cause hospitals to close again.

We have to vote like our lives depend on it. Because for many Americans – it will. https://t.co/yuI5PwxNdy

Climate change is making it more expensive for Americans to insure their homes or small businesses. For many, it can be nearly impossible to get an affordable policy. 

We need to work urgently to bring these costs down and expand coverage. https://t.co/xBYVQZK65D

Republicans’ One Big Ugly Bill will be an unmitigated disaster for our economy and our country. This bill will result in the closure of hospitals and clinics, kick millions of Americans off their health care and slash food assistance, all in order to give a massive tax cut to wealthy people and corporations, while borrowing even more money from our kids to do it.  
  
No matter what Republicans say, let’s talk about what’s really in this bill:  
  
It will gut food assistance — a lifeline for seniors, working families, pregnant women, and children, who will go hungry.
  
It will slash Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act, and lead to hundreds of billions of dollars in cuts to Medicare funding, kicking millions of Californians off of their health care when they can least afford it. 
 
It will shutter labor and delivery units and put hospitals at risk of closure around the country, especially in rural and underserved communities, leaving families with nowhere to seek care.   
  
It will decimate clean energy projects, cause hundreds of thousands of job losses, lead to higher energy bills every year, and put us behind China.  
  
It will skyrocket the national debt and deficit, leaving it for our children and grandchildren to pay — hypocrisy of the rankest order.  
  
Americans and Californians are hurting. Prices continue to go up. Housing continues to be unaffordable. And this bill will make things worse — much worse.   
  
What Californians need right now is a government that is working for them – not fighting against them.   
  
We should be focused on bringing down costs, expanding health care for millions, creating economic opportunities, and safeguarding Americans’ hard-earned ability to retire with dignity.   
  
This bill does just the opposite and will cause pain and hardship for millions of families.

And that’s why I’ll be voting no.

At number 3 - Stripping away healthcare for millions of Americans.

Everyone, Medicaid recipient or not, will feel the effects of these senseless cuts when hospitals close, clinics close, and your medical bills go up. https://t.co/t1YYbDFsDI

The massive transfer of the personal data of millions of Medicaid recipients should alarm every American. This massive violation of our privacy laws must be halted immediately.

It will harm families across the nation and only cause more citizens to forego lifesaving access to health care.

The President is deeply unpopular. His agenda is stunningly unpopular. The Big Ugly Bill — with its vast cuts to healthcare to fund tax cuts for the rich — is historically unpopular. 

So Trump leveraged Republicans in Texas to try to gerrymander a majority in the midterms.

But they poked the bear. And California is going to fight back.

22 million Americans are facing major price hikes for their health care, thanks to Donald Trump and his Big Ugly Bill.

The Republican budget means huge cuts to Medicaid, rural hospital closures, and higher out-of-pocket costs for families across the nation. Together, these failures will force millions of Americans to go without health insurance. 

All to pay for big billionaire tax breaks.

When Republicans cut Medicaid, they cut funding to hospitals.

When they cut hospital funding, they cut critical hospital staff.

When they cut hospital staff, it puts lives at risk.

Just another consequence of the GOP's Big Ugly Bill. https://t.co/Nk27IOhZWb

Today, I’m introducing the Empowering Striking Workers Act.

So that workers who have to go on strike can use their unemployment insurance to get by.

Because when workers have to fight for better wages, it shouldn’t be only the corporate executives who can feed their families.

In two weeks, the government may shut down because Republicans refuse to negotiate.

Tonight, we're showing the country what Democrats stand for:

-> Averting a shutdown

-> Reversing devastating healthcare cuts

-> Permanently blocking health insurance premium hikes

-> Preventing Donald Trump from reneging on spending agreements
